name: h3.k_ring_features
description: All features within k-ring of an H3 cell
querySql: SELECT DISTINCT f.id, f.external_id, ST_AsGeoJSON(f.geometry)::jsonb AS geometry, f.attributes FROM tessera.h3_cell_index h JOIN tessera.geo_features f ON f.id = h.feature_id AND f.ingested_at = h.feature_ingest WHERE h.resolution = :resolution AND h.h3_index = ANY(h3_grid_disk(:h3CellAddress::h3index, :k))
